summary: Executed focused frontend-only regression on the public preview URL for header/footer redesign requirements: responsive chrome, route/header surface behavior, mobile/tablet menu dialog behavior, footer download/links, reduced-motion safety, and hash-anchor integration.
action_items: Optional hardening: if desired, expose a deterministic test hook/helper for Lenis top-scroll state to avoid false negatives with direct window.scrollTo() in automation.
Optional cleanup: review recurring non-blocking external console warnings from emergent telemetry script (container positioning warning) if production console hygiene is required.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical functional regressions found in this pass. Header/footer/mobile-menu implementation matches requested responsive and interaction behavior across tested breakpoints.
Main content remains visible during rapid route changes; no blank-page recurrence observed.
No app-origin JS runtime errors were detected in tested flows; observed request aborts were tied to telemetry/maps/resource cancellation during navigation and did not break UX.
test_credentials: No auth needed; public frontend only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated exact screenshot viewports (1920x800, 390x844), plus programmatic width checks (320/768/1024/1279/1280/1440). Confirmed: wordmark uppercase SUVI + INTERIOR, nav/menu breakpoint behavior, no document overflow, hero/header spacing, all inner routes solid header, mobile menu inert/focus-trap/Escape/route-close/resize-unlock, footer preview/download/legal/back-to-top, reduced-motion immediate text visibility, /services#modular-kitchens anchor offset. No unresolved functional bugs found in this scope.
rca_of_the_issue: No new blocking issue reproduced. Earlier apparent home top-state restoration failure was caused by test-side direct window.scrollTo interaction under Lenis smooth-scrolling context; user-path back-to-top flow worked correctly and restored top/header focus.
